note: Rue des Maisons (S02 Home) square, widened Oct 22 2026 (streets v2) so every street mouth is painted: the same Maison familiale (quilted blue-grey duvet roof, white teapot chimney, white stucco, green doors/shutters, garage, copper pan, kennel, stone garden arch) now stands in the middle of a wider cobbled square. Left to right: the canal quay with steps down to the water by a whitewashed, teal-shuttered house with a washing line (Quai du Lavoir), the broad stone stairway climbing between autumn trees (Montée des Habitudes), the rose-covered wooden arch (Ruelle du Sommeil), the house's doors, the stone pulley arch onto a cherry-blossom lane (Chemin des Gestes) and, on the far right, the plane-tree avenue between pale lemon houses (Avenue des Petits Travaux). The near cobbles walk back to the village square (S01). On the far left, the ground floor of the teal-shuttered house opens into the glass-roofed arcade of the Passage des Paquets (parcels stacked by the arch).
